sentence: This project builds a score that combines RNA sequencing data, digital pathomic features and clinical data to predict how long people with oral cancer survive.
This project expands the genetic tests and sequencing methods used to look for hidden genetic risk factors in Alzheimer's disease and frontotemporal dementia.
This project studies how muscle stem cells and the cells around them rebuild muscle, and how this changes in muscle wasting diseases of children.
This project studies how chemicals and other environmental factors affect human health, using human subjects, genetically modified mice or other models.
This project studies how skin cells mature and form a barrier, to better understand skin diseases such as psoriasis and skin cancer.
This project builds sensitive detection devices and machine learning tools to sort extracellular vesicles, which may show early signs of ovarian cancer.
This project tests whether a weakened strain of Listeria monocytogenes can act as a cancer vaccine that switches on immune cells to fight tumors.
This project studies what stops breast cancer patients in Nigeria from getting care that follows guidelines, and tests ways to help doctors follow them.
This project uses genetic information from a biobank to find adults at high genetic risk for diabetes and tests how they respond to medications.
This project develops magnetic resonance imaging techniques to see how the muscles and the knee change during exercise in people with knee osteoarthritis.
This project combines DNA base editor mutations with screens across the proteome to find which phosphorylation sites affect how T cells work.
This project studies how autophagy limits fusion oncogene expression to certain cell types and how much this response is shared across cells.
This project uses an imaging catheter that fits an endoscope to watch how strictures in the gut change after balloon or stent dilation.
This project studies how senescent cells make infections by viruses, bacteria and fungi worse in older people, including differences between the sexes.
This project studies a master regulator of drug-resistant genes in multiple myeloma and tests a combination therapy against tumor cells and immunosuppressive cells.
This project supports clinical trials of cancer treatments across a network of researchers in Canada.
This project develops a method that lets PET imaging track several radiotracers at the same time to learn more about tumors.
This project builds neuronal cell models from patients to find out why the peripheral nervous system fails in Sanfilippo Syndrome and to find drug candidates.
This project uses liquid biopsy tests to track how metastatic prostate cancer becomes resistant to targeted therapies.
